title: An order search puts the query status into the SQL text

pr.title: Add an order search with a status filter, a sort, and a limit
pr.description: GET /orders lists the orders of the signed-in customer. The query takes status, sort (newest, oldest, total), and limit (1 to 100).

bugs.note: status comes from request.args (web/orders.py) and goes into the SQL text in quotes. status=x' OR 1=1 -- returns the orders of every customer, and a UNION SELECT reads other tables. The module doc says that a request value goes in as a ? parameter, as get_order and count_by_status do. Use status = ? and pass (customer_id, status).

traps.why: column comes from SORT_COLUMNS, a fixed map. An unknown sort key gives the newest column, so no request text reaches ORDER BY. An SQL injection finding here is wrong.
int(limit) is an integer, and the route clamps it to 1 to 100. No request text reaches LIMIT, so an SQL injection finding here is wrong.
